channel.title: Tony Koo Research
channel.description: Essays on machine learning, agentic systems, cloud architecture and decisions under uncertainty.

item.title: How coding agents find and change code
item.description: A useful coding agent narrows the search, checks its evidence, edits within a boundary and proves the patch worked.

item.title: From specification to verified release
item.description: A clear specification, reviewed plan and layered tests turn an agent run into an accountable software change.

item.title: When an ML model is ready for production
item.description: A strong validation score is a start. Deployment needs a baseline, leakage checks and a plan for changing data.

item.title: How data becomes reliable evidence
item.description: A good answer needs a trustworthy record, a search method suited to the question and a path back to the source.

item.title: How to choose a system boundary
item.description: Draw the line where state is committed, work is handed off and failures can be retried safely.

item.title: What the cloud should own
item.description: Managed infrastructure removes some work, but ownership of data, access, recovery and cost still needs a name.

item.title: How to decide under uncertainty
item.description: A good process records what was known, what was assumed and what would change your mind.

item.title: How money compounds and risk interrupts it
item.description: Time helps only when a plan can survive its cash needs, costs and the investor’s own behavior.

item.title: What language models learn
item.description: Separate learned weights, task context and verification before trying to fix a weak answer.

item.title: When agents need search
item.description: Choose the smallest control loop that improves validated outcomes, and be explicit about what branches.

item.title: Where autonomy stops
item.description: Let models propose actions while independent controls decide which effects are allowed.

item.title: How to prove an agent works
item.description: Compare a strong simple baseline with an agent under the same conditions, then inspect outcomes and costs.
